summary: Iterates an 8x8 grid of 9-dword records starting at 'this', calling ArithmeticComparison_d8c0 on every element with a2, then performs one final ArithmeticComparison_d8c0 on the element at 'this + 576' and returns its result. Each inner iteration advances the element pointer by 9 dwords. Called by ConditionalCleanupChain (0x0040F100) and StateDependentUpdateDispatch (0x0040F130).

operations.description: Outer do-while loop with counter v3 seeded at 8, running the inner grid pass 8 times.
Inner do-while loop with counter v4 seeded at 8, visiting 8 consecutive records each pass.
Call ArithmeticComparison_d8c0(v2, a2) on each element pointer as the pointer advances through the grid.
Advance the element pointer by 9 dwords per inner iteration: v2 += 9.
After the nested loops, call ArithmeticComparison_d8c0(this + 576, a2) on the final element.
Return the result of the final ArithmeticComparison_d8c0(this + 576, a2) call.

unresolved: Record layout of the 9-dword elements and the meaning of a2 depend on ArithmeticComparison_d8c0 and the two callers.
The final element at 'this + 576' sits just past the 64-element grid (64 * 9 = 576 dwords); its special handling is unexplained by this function alone.
